sentences.en: Drive to the next intersection and make a left turn.
sentences.zh: 开到下一个十字路口然后左转。

sentences.en: Someone ploughed into me from behind at an intersection yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天在十字路口后面有人撞上了我。

sentences.en: You should slow down when you approach a four-way intersection.
sentences.zh: 接近四岔路口时你应该减速。

senses.zh: 横断，横切,交叉，相交,交叉点，交叉线,数交集
